assets.subject: A mortgage adviser and prospective buyers compare distinct evidence sheets before a lending decision.
assets.lightPrompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: OPDA Finance and Banking working-group card, new replacement artwork. Generate ONE image, exact 1200 x 300 pixels, ultra-wide 4:1 composition, matching the existing image slot. Input image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE only: preserve its refined ink and rich watercolour voice, NOT its house-and-coins composition.
Scene: an experienced mortgage adviser and a couple considering a home purchase sit in a calm advice room in a shallow left-to-right narrative. The adviser at left opens a source folder; one prospective buyer at centre compares two separate unlettered evidence sheets while the other listens, hands naturally resting near a pencil. At far right a broad window shows a modest British terraced home, connecting the decision to a real dwelling. Calm attentive expressions, no congratulation or implied loan approval. The different documents remain distinct and visible.
Style: expressive organic pen-and-ink contours, rich translucent watercolour and softly opaque gouache, delicate hatching, visible pigment texture, warm professional editorial storytelling. Cool off-white #F9F9F9 paper, deep-purple #231F2F ink, generous OPDA golden-yellow #FEC92B, petrol/teal #0E8478, violet #6C5BD4 and coral accents, natural skin tones. Colour substantial surfaces, not pale generic line art.
Composition: unusually shallow panorama filling the width, complete heads, natural hands and useful objects safely within image, no clipped people, no enormous blank bands. Not a grid or contact sheet. No readable text, digits, symbols, labels, arrows, coins, charts, approval stamps, handshake, logos, watermark, floating icons, 3D, photography, neon or glow. No architectural cutaway: this subject concerns human financial judgement.

assets.subject: Practitioners compare separate property-title and enquiry sketches with source folders and search papers.
assets.lightPrompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: new OPDA Conveyancing working-group card. Input image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE only, not subject or composition.
Scene: a close, low horizontal study of a property conveyancing case opened on a long shallow archive ledge. At left a pair of practitioner's hands unfolds a large title-boundary sketch showing one modest terraced home and its garden plot; in the middle several clearly separate violet, teal and golden source folders lean against a small stack of search papers; at right another hand compares a separate coral enquiry sheet with the property sketch. Two sets of careful hands, no faces needed. All papers are blank apart from purely pictorial unlabelled house/plot drawings, no text or numbers. The story is separate legal evidence being compared before transfer, not approval or a completed transaction. No gavel, scales of justice, seal, checkmark, handshake, coins or courthouse.
Style: refined organic purple pen-and-ink, rich translucent watercolour and softly opaque gouache, paper highlights, delicate hatching, generous OPDA gold #FEC92B, petrol/teal #0E8478, violet #6C5BD4 and coral on cool off-white #F9F9F9 paper. Strong readable silhouettes and tactile pigment. Familiar warm professional OPDA editorial voice, no 3D, photography, glossy vector or glow.
PRODUCTION GEOMETRY: generate one 2172×724 3:1 canvas, BUT compose the entire drawing inside central 4:1 artwork strip y=110..615 and x=20..2150, safe within eventual y=91..633 crop. Top and bottom 91 pixels must be completely empty uniform off-white paper, NO border. All hands and objects complete within strip. This deliberate blank padding will be removed for exactly1200×300 final card. Spread scene laterally and keep shallow; no clipped subject, grid, montage, text, label, logo or watermark.
